messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P2 — model-serving: higher tail latency detected for text-generation (region: us-west-2). Alerting primary oncall. Link: https://redwood.internal/bridges/INC-4021 :rotating_light:

Alex G: yep seeing it. latency 95p ~6.3s on recent traces. rolling alerts for a few customers. I have a flight delay and need to swap primary tonight — can hand off at 17:30 UTC. paging still on me until handoff.

Tara L: I can take primary from 17:30 UTC if Miguel is ok to be sec. I can stay on for the next 4h.

Miguel R: I can be secondary. if things go south and we need a rapid rollback, I can jump in. leaving my number in case bridge drops: +1-555-0199.

Alex G: thanks. quick summary for handoff:
- incident state: ongoing, spike started ~16:45 UTC, error rates unchanged, only tail latency.
- customer impact: interactive chat timeouts for ~3-5% of sessions for a small set of high-throughput customers. no data exfiltration.
- mitigation tried: autoscale bumped two pools, cache priming attempted, no visible reduction.
- suspected cause: kv-cache eviction + longer compiles on cold paths.

Tara L: grabbing runbook now. can you paste the immediate triage commands and any relevant traces?

Alex G: pasted snippets below (from infra runbook):
```
# Check per-pod tail latency and OOMs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-serving --tail 200 | grep "latency_p95"
# Check cache hit ratio
curl -s http://cache-metrics.internal/kv/cache_hit_ratio | jq .
```
Also bridge has the APM link with flamegraphs: https://apm.internal/app/123/trace/INC-4021

oncall-rotation-bot: @Tara L is now scheduled as primary for 17:30 UTC - 21:30 UTC. @Miguel R set as secondary for the same window. Please acknowledge with `:thumbsup:`.

Tara L: :thumbsup: acknowledged. I'll post a short checklist at 17:25 and take over bridge.

Miguel R: :thumbsup: acknowledged. I'll stand by and monitor autoscaler and GPU queue depth.

Alex G: leaving a quick note for whoever picks this up later: if the KV cache hit ratio is <65% try forced warmup via `/admin/warm_cache --models=text-gen --sync` (use low concurrency), and avoid mass recoil of inferences while warming.

Tara L: got it. I'll run warmup as step 2 if autoscale doesn't bring latency down within 10m.

Miguel R: reminder to update the incident doc with any customer contacts and mark any high-traffic tenants under watch. I opened JIRA INC-4021 with the initial blurb.

Alex G: posted contact list in the doc — cc: @support-escalations for impacted customers.

Tara L: small follow-up: can someone confirm whether Dedicated customers in eu-west-1 see the same tail? I only see us-west-2 in dashboards.

Miguel R: quick check: eu-west-1 shows normal p95 (~300ms). looks regional to us-west-2.

Tara L: ok — that's good, will scope mitigations to us-west-2 first.

oncall-rotation-bot: handoff completed. Primary: Tara L (17:30 UTC), Secondary: Miguel R (17:30 UTC). Pager updates propagated.

Alex G: thanks all — I'm stepping out now. Tara/Miguel, ping me if you need a deeper walkthrough; I'll be reachable but offline boarding soon.

Tara L: thanks Alex — safe travels. starting takeover checklist: 1) confirm bridge, 2) validate autoscaler backoffs, 3) run cache warmup if needed, 4) notify support if impact persists past 30m.

Miguel R: adding to checklist: 5) monitor GPU queue depth and reclaim stalled actors if queue > 80% for 5m.

Tara L: noted. I'll update incident doc every 15m and call for an SRE sync if mitigations don't reduce 95p below 1s within 30m.

Alex G: thank you — handing off now :wave:
